subject: Post-call: FintechAI — cost/pricing qualification & latency trade-offs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@fintechai.com>, Sam Chen <sam@fintechai.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: FintechAI — cost/pricing qualification & latency trade-offs

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we can size an initial pricing estimate: 

Summary of asks / notes from call:
- Peak qps: ~120 RPS for conversational assistant during business hours (estimated).
- Avg tokens per request: ~450 tokens (prompt + expected generation).
- Monthly active users: ~60k, projected ~1.8M requests/mo (spiky).
- Target budget range: $8k–$18k / month to start (open to committed capacity discussion).
- Latency SLO: p95 goal ~250ms for short flows; some higher-latency async flows ok.

Cost / unit economics discussion items we need to confirm:
1) Target $/1M tokens: you mentioned target approx $120–$220 per 1M tokens depending on latency tier — please confirm.
2) Traffic shape: percent of streaming vs sync requests (streaming helps perceived latency for longer responses).
3) Acceptable fallback model: do you need guaranteed model parity on fallbacks?

Our initial recommendation (based on the call):
- If p95 target <=250ms and token volumes stay high, consider Dedicated Tier (reserved capacity) with configured batching + streaming to keep unit cost near $110–$140 / 1M tokens.
- If you prefer OPEX & lighter commit, Hosted Tier with autoscaling and streaming is possible but unit cost will be ~20–40% higher at these volumes.

Next steps:
- Jamie / Sam: share a 7-day traffic sample (CSV) with timestamps + tokens/request and annotate flow types (chat vs async) — we attached fintechai_traffic_sample.csv for format.
- We (Marissa + Rachel) will produce a 2-option estimate (hosted vs dedicated) and outline expected $/1M tokens and recommended batching/streaming settings.
- Proposed timeline: estimate back to you by EOD Friday (11/6).

Attachments: redwood_pricing_estimate_fintechai.xlsx (placeholder — will be filled after we receive traffic sample).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@fintechai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Chen <sam@fintechai.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: FintechAI — cost/pricing qualification & latency trade-offs

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few quick clarifications: 

- Our target $/1M tokens was a ballpark — internally we'd be happy with $150 or lower for the core assistant flows. For lower-priority analytic jobs we can tolerate $250+/1M.
- Traffic shape: about 70% conversational (short to mid responses, ~300–700 tokens), 20% longer analytic generations (~2k tokens) run off hours, 10% embeddings/rerank. We use streaming in product for the user-facing chat.
- Fallback model: we'd prefer graceful degradation to a smaller model as long as intent/slot extraction remains accurate.

I'll upload a 7-day sample match to your CSV format later today (will include tokens/request and a flow_type column).

One more ask — can you provide expected p95 latency numbers for the two pricing tiers (Hosted Tier with streaming + Dedicated Tier with batching)? That will help our infra team evaluate.

Best,
Jamie
Jamie Liu
Head of Product, FintechAI
jamie.liu@fintechai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@fintechai.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T18:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: FintechAI — cost/pricing qualification & latency trade-offs

Appreciate the details, Jamie — that's exactly what we needed. Quick answers to your latency question and how it maps to cost tiers: 

- Hosted Tier (streaming + autoscale): typical p95 for conversational flows ~300–450ms depending on concurrency and prompt length; unit cost estimate: $160–$220 / 1M tokens for your expected mix.
- Dedicated Tier (reserved capacity, controlled batching + streaming): typical p95 ~180–300ms at planned loads; unit cost estimate: $95–$140 / 1M tokens depending on commit level and model variant.

Notes on batching vs streaming:
- Streaming improves perceived latency for long outputs (user sees tokens asap) and plays nicely with UI. It can increase tail latency slightly if not tuned, but it's generally preferred for chat UX.
- Aggressive batching reduces unit costs but raises p95; we can tune max batch window to hit your SLOs (e.g., 10–30ms batch window for low-latency flow).

I'll attach the preliminary pricing workbook and a short note on recommended batch settings. Once we have your traffic sample we'll run a simulated cost model and firm up the numbers.

Next: we'll send the estimate by EOD Fri; if we need a deeper infra call, Rachel and our Solutions Engineer can join early next week.

—Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: FintechAI — cost/pricing qualification & latency trade-offs

Looping in quickly — thanks Marissa/Jamie. If FintechAI can commit to a 6–12 month reserved capacity we can tighten the Dedicated Tier numbers by ~10–20% and guarantee the p95 SLOs in the contract.

Marissa — let's include a clear SLA appendix and a draft MA/commit range in the estimate. Jamie — if you can share the traffic sample this morning we'll prioritize the simulation and aim for an updated workbook by EOD.

Vivek
